defs.def: to make sth longer, wider or looser, for example by pulling it; to become longer, etc. in this way 拉长；拽宽；撑大；抻松

ex.s: While Emily was driving on a narrow stretch of road, her car slid into a ditch (沟).
ex.t: 当Emily行驶在一段狭窄的路上时，她的车滑进了沟里。

ex.s: I ____44____ beekeeper Ziyad over a wide stretch of grassland before entering a thick jungle.
ex.t: 进入茂密丛林前，我____44____养蜂人齐亚德走过一片广阔的草地。

defs.def: to become bigger or longer when you pull it and return to its original shape when you stop 织物
to pull sth so that it is smooth and tight 拉紧；拉直；绷紧
to put your arms or legs out straight and contract your muscles 伸展；舒展
to put out an arm or a leg in order to reach sth 伸出，伸长（胳膊、腿）
to spread over an area of land 延伸；绵延
to continue over a period of time 延续
to be enough to buy or pay for sth 用于否定句和疑问句，指一笔钱
to make use of a lot of your money, supplies, time, etc. （大量地）使用，消耗
to make use of all sb's skill, intelligence, etc. 使竭尽所能；使全力以赴；使发挥出全部本领
to use sth in a way that would not normally be considered fair, acceptable, etc. 滥用；随意歪曲
an area of land or water, especially a long one 一片；一泓；一段
a continuous period of time （连续的）一段时间
a period of time that sb spends in prison 服刑期
an act of stretching out your arms or legs or your body and contracting the muscles; the state of being stretched 伸展；舒展

ex.s: Helping strangers can leave you with a deep sense of satisfaction, but you’ve likely also felt the stress of showing up for others when you’re already stretched thin.
ex.t: 这些平凡的时刻引出了一个哲学难题：有道德的人更幸福吗？____其他人可能会认为道德行为往往需要自我牺牲。

ex.s: However, when a cat is looking for affection, they tend to produce stretched and soft meows.
ex.t: 然而，当猫想寻求爱抚时，它们往往发出拖长而轻柔的喵叫。

ex.s: On each floor, hallways stretched in four directions, leading to classrooms, laboratories, and teachers’ offices.
ex.t: 最有效的生活方式是努力成为那种罕见的混合体——狐狸式刺猍。

defs.def: the ability to be made longer or wider without breaking or tearing 弹性；伸缩性

ex.s: Is it its forests that stretch on and on like great green seas?
ex.t: 是它的森林像浩瀚的绿色海洋一样绵延不绝吗？

ex.s: She goes down from the block, stops, looks wistfully back,–her daughter stretches her hands towards her.
ex.t: 她从断头台走下，停下脚步，怅然若失地回望——她的女儿向她伸出双手。

ex.s: Continuous as the stars that shine And twinkle on the milky way, They stretched in never-ending line Along the margin of a bay: Ten thousand saw I at a glance, Tossing their heads in sprightly dance.
ex.t: 如银河中闪烁的群星连绵不断，它们沿着水湾的边缘伸向无尽的远方：我一眼便望见万千，它们欢快地摇着头起舞。

ex.s: After staying in the sleeping bag the whole night, I really needed to stretch my legs.
ex.t: 在睡袋里待了整整一夜后，我真的很需要伸伸腿。

ex.s: Stretching over 2,300 kilometres, the Great Barrier Reef is considered one of the natural wonders of the world.
ex.t: 大堡礁绵延2300多公里，被认为是世界自然奇观之一。

defs.def: a straight part at the end of a racing track （终点）直道
